Start Building Read the Docs

Skills

Create instruction sets that give A.T.L.A.S new capabilities and knowledge. Write in Markdown, no coding required.

MCP Servers

Build Model Context Protocol servers that connect A.T.L.A.S to external services and APIs.

Tools

Create custom tools with TypeScript that A.T.L.A.S can use to perform specific actions.

How It Works

1

Register as a Developer

Create your developer account and submit for approval. We review all developers to ensure quality.

2

Build Your Extension

Use our SDK and documentation to create Skills, MCP Servers, or Tools. Test locally with the A.T.L.A.S dev environment.

3

Submit for Review

Upload your extension with a description, screenshots, and icon. Our team reviews for quality and security.

4

Reach Users

Once approved, your extension appears in the A.T.L.A.S Store. Users can install with one click.
